comparison.objective: Install an 18650 cell with correct polarity and latch the welder lid; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Extract a cell from a tight holder, reorient it upright-to-horizontal, seat it in a close bay, and press a snap latch while stabilizing the tool; candidate uses a fine hex tool and adjustable collar.
comparison.success_condition: Cell must be seated positive-end-first within 3 mm/10 degrees, lid latched within 2 degrees, and welder safely released; candidate requires two quantified safe stopping cycles.
comparison.reason: Battery insertion, polarity, and snap-latching test different mechanics and outcomes from damper calibration.
